name: smwmusic-castlevania-vicious-cycle-of-corruption-wicked-child-remix
title: Castlevania - Vicious Cycle Of Corruption ~ Wicked Child (Remix)
description:
𝖄𝖔𝖚 𝖍𝖆𝖛𝖊 𝖇𝖊𝖊𝖓 𝖉𝖔𝖔𝖒𝖊𝖉 𝖊𝖛𝖊𝖗 𝖘𝖎𝖓𝖈𝖊 𝖞𝖔𝖚 𝖑𝖔𝖘𝖙 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝖆𝖇𝖎𝖑𝖎𝖙𝖞 𝖙𝖔 𝖑𝖔𝖛𝖊.

Did an arrangement of Wicked Child from Castlevania. Got some heavy inspiration from this one arranged version I heard in a Doom mod (Castlevania: Simon's Destiny) and really wanted to do my own take on the theme after hearing that.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. D Minor (Original Pitch)
3. E Minor (Custom Pitch)
